d: A mechanical quadrupedal combat robot with a heavy, industrial build, featuring a color palette of pale grey and charcoal grey plating with orange accent stripes. The entity is equipped with a massive, long-barrelled cannon extending forward and a large vertical armor plate on its rear marked with the alphanumeric code "C0B3". Small, glowing red optical sensors serve as eyes on its armored head, while two thin antennas extend from the top of its chassis. BODY COLOR: pale grey and charcoal grey
